params.message: sights down an unloaded rifle at the far wall and nods to himself.

chitchat: "Vega's the best trigger work in the district. Don't haggle her."
description: A broad-shouldered regular loitering by the firing lane, running a bore snake through a rifle he clearly doesn't need to sell. Vega's ledger has him down as DURO, M., and has done for eleven years.

root.text: He barely glances up. "New iron? Vega'll sort you." He runs the bore snake through one more time. "Duro. I'm here Tuesdays."

clothing_layers: a plate carrier over a range jacket

name: Marek Duro
